summary.text: A ruin bat corpse is the body of a ruin bat, including the immemorial ruin bat corpse used as a corpse mountain in Tai Qiu.

claims.text: Dong Fang Chang Fan places his wisdom path inheritance on the corpse of a ruin bat in the depths of Tai Qiu. While alive that ruin bat was an immemorial desolate beast with the battle strength of a rank eight Gu Immortal, a space path desolate beast whose space path dao marks construct a land of illusory large halls. Gu Immortals hesitate above the ruin bat’s corpse while Dong Fang Yu Liang enters the halls.

He chose an immemorial ruin bat corpse as the inheritance ground for a reason: a huge phantom beast army rises from beneath invaders, and phantom beasts thrive where space path dao marks are numerous. Fairy Li Shan judges that without an ancient desolate beast level phantom beast, they can eventually enter the immemorial ruin bat’s corpse.

When Fang Yuan smashes the surrounding space path dao marks, the concealment illusion fails and the immemorial desolate beast level ruin bat corpse’s true appearance is exposed. The body sprawls hundreds of meters across, its wings covering a few li of sand, and a deep wound on its back holds thick space path dao marks that conjure a small space with a ruined hall inside.

The phantom formation releases a thick blood-colored veil that covers the main location in the ruin bat’s corpse. From outside, an incomparably large blood veil covers the ruin bat’s corpse like a mountain; demonic path attacks only make slight ripples and leave the veil standing stable.

Dong Fang Chang Fan remodeled the immemorial ruin bat’s corpse and connected it to the ground to form a mountain based on the corpse, linking it to the surrounding landscape as a true corpse mountain that Pulling Mountain Immortal Gu can target.
When Fang Yuan forcibly stops Pulling Mountain under life chasing fire, the ruin bat’s corpse mountain falls heavily, cracking the ground and throwing stone and dust.

During Dong Fang Yu Liang’s immortal ascension, earth ghost lightning balls impact the ruin bat’s corpse mountain from round craters around the corpse, and twin lightnings of heaven and earth wreck the immemorial ruin bat’s corpse beyond recognition. Densely packed space path dao marks around the ruin bat are almost completely cleared by those tribulations. A piercing explosion of white light shoots from the ruin bat’s corpse, and afterward nothing remains of the enormous corpse mountain.

Soul searching Dong Fang Chang Fan yields the memory of remodeling the immemorial ruin bat’s corpse, including the method of enslaving phantom beasts and the secret of turning a normal Gu formation into a phantom formation.

Remodeling the immemorial ruin bat’s corpse into a corpse mountain is the main condition for using that corpse’s power to control a phantom beast army and turn a normal Gu formation phantom. After heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity wreck most of the ruin bat corpse mountain and strip its aura, desolate and ancient desolate beasts gather to feast on the ruin bat’s corpse.

Inside a space path Gu formation packed with beast corpses, Fang Yuan finds a ruin bat among the specimens: a rare space path desolate beast, inferior to the immemorial desolate beast ruin bat he saw in Tai Qiu.

Dong Fang Chang Fan once set a battle stage using an immemorial ruin bat’s corpse; the immemorial desolate beast’s aura deterred other desolate beasts and ancient desolate beasts so no beast tide formed. When tribulations eliminated that aura, the immemorial ruin bat’s corpse was immediately split up and devoured by countless desolate beasts and ancient desolate beasts.

Inside a purple blood river formation with phantom path effects, thirty to forty ruin bat corpses must be cleared or the phantom path effects will not end. Most are desolate level, with some ancient ruin bats and even an immemorial ruin bat, and the blood river melts those corpses rapidly as purple thoughts turn from solid to phantom.
